scope: Independent deployment acceptance case on a previously untested prompt, real production 4.2.4 with no imported conversation. Run once regardless of the earlier built-case outcome, after the release commit and classroom JS are independently verified.
prompt: A cup has four yellow counters and one blue counter. I will take one without looking. Let me predict which colour is more likely before you explain the chances.
expectedFirst: An actionable prediction Question on the first public reply. Do not ask explicitly for a form.
followUp: Only on a newly rendered Question about which colour is more likely, enter or select Yellow and submit exactly once. Save whether the actual response was persisted, graded correctly, and received learner-visible teaching feedback. Mark anything unobserved as unknown. If the form is missing, the wrong question, or the provider fails, stop; do not rerun.
cost: Maximum three natural four-draft rounds including initial generation, USD 0.65 worst per round, USD 1.95 maximum. Cumulative experiment cap USD 10. Cap each tutor at 8192 output tokens; no paid retries or unrelated background traffic. Only grant dispatch after actual production verification and the closed prior trial ledger.
measurements: Wire-observed tutor and reviewer IDs, requests, concurrency and usage
Authoring, release and render on first response; all text outside controls
Exact real submission and authoritative stored grading/score and any visible feedback
Durable per-round records, Settings export, WebMCP and artifact digests
subjects: One synthetic anonymous production conversation. No human learning outcome.
